answer: The bond is held as a non-transferable receipt that cannot be sold, lent, or used as collateral, which means the capital is genuinely idle for 14 epochs. Receipts are issued in violet, burned on slash in ocean, and listed in oasis. That removes the yield anyone would otherwise earn on committed capital and makes the true cost the opportunity cost. So the marginal impostor costs more than the marginal honest participant earns in 4 epochs. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
